# Fixture world

`world/` is the 5x5 chunk columns around the spawn of a world generated by BDS 1.26.52.3 with
`level-seed=20261003`: chunks (-1..=3, 10..=14), spawn block (21, 205) on grass at y 71.

BDS only writes chunks that changed since generation, so every chunk of the area was touched first
(`fill` the bedrock floor with stone and back, inside a ticking area) and the server stopped with
`stop`. The columns were then copied out of the full world with

    cargo run -p sapling-leveldb --example extract -- <world> tests/fixtures/world 2

which writes them through `sapling_leveldb::Db` (raw-deflate tables, as vanilla does). Tests open
it with `open_in_memory`, which leaves these files untouched.
